Common.footerEvidence: Only content allowed by public contracts and complete evidence is shown.
Common.notFoundDescription: This public page does not exist, has been withdrawn, or is not currently visible.
Common.errorDescription: The public data service cannot complete this request right now. Try again later.

Home.title: Start with data identity. Find lifecycle evidence you can explain, compare, and cite.
Home.description: Search public Processes and Flows by UUID, CAS, classification code, or name. Values appear only when license, context, and publication evidence are complete.
Home.searchPlaceholder: Enter a UUID, CAS, classification code, or name
Home.privacy: Keywords appear in browser history and platform access logs. Do not enter confidential information.
Home.browseDescription: Directory entry points use stable and traceable public dimensions only.
Home.scaleUnavailable: Public statistics are currently unavailable. Scale and update time remain unprovided rather than inferred.
Home.advancedTitle: Need modeling, editing, or team workflows?
Home.advancedDescription: The Portal is for anonymous public discovery. Advanced work continues in the TianGong LCA workspace.

Search.title: Search the public catalog
Search.description: Keywords, UUIDs, CAS numbers, and classifications share one public-catalog ordering. Private, team, and review data is never included.
Search.label: Search query
Search.privacy: GET queries appear in browser history and platform access logs. Do not enter confidential information.
Search.initialTitle: Enter a public identifier or keyword
Search.initialDescription: Natural-language Hybrid Search is not part of R1. The baseline catalog always uses deterministic lexical or identifier search.
Search.emptyTitle: No public results can be shown
Search.emptyDescription: Check the identifier, shorten the query, or remove filters. Private data is never used to fill gaps.
Search.unavailableTitle: The public catalog is temporarily unavailable
Search.unavailableDescription: Public records cannot be read right now. Try again later or adjust the filters.

Browse.title: Browse: {dimension}
Browse.description: This directory only uses stable dimensions explicitly supplied by the upstream public contract. The Portal does not infer groups.
Browse.emptyTitle: No entries can be shown in this directory
Browse.emptyDescription: Try another directory or public search. Groups not supplied upstream are never inferred.

Detail.recordPending: This exact public version cannot be displayed right now.
Detail.citationUnavailable: An exact-version citation is available after the public record resolves.
Detail.exchangesDescription: Each value needs Process, Flow, direction, unit, functional-unit, and capability context.
Detail.exchangesEmpty: No Exchange value has complete public context. Missing values are never replaced with zero.
Detail.lciaDescription: Only immutable values bound to the current public publication are read.
Detail.lciaUnavailable: There is no visible published LCIA projection. The result is unavailable, not zero.
Detail.lciaGuardUnavailable: The signed entry point or safety guard is unavailable; database verification was not bypassed.
Detail.versionsDescription: Each version has an exact link. The latest alias is not canonical.
Detail.versionsEmpty: No public version history can be shown yet.
Detail.methodEmpty: System boundary, allocation, modeling, and cutoff rules are not available from the public contract.
Detail.qualityEmpty: No quality scale is drawn without its scale and source rule.
Detail.provenanceEmpty: The public contract provides no source record, import batch, or normalization rule.

Compare.title: Deterministic comparison
Compare.description: Functional unit, method, geography, time, and system boundary are checked first. LCIA values align only when every numeric context is compatible.
Compare.emptyDescription: Add candidates from search or details. Comparison links contain exact member IDs only.
Compare.metadataOnly: Only metadata is compared. Missing or incompatible LCIA values are not aligned.
Compare.numericContext: These values passed exact Process, functional unit, geography, reference year, method, unit, and publication consistency checks.

Collections.title: Local collection
Collections.description: Research name, purpose, decisions, and notes stay in this browser and are never sent to the server.
Collections.warningTitle: This is not a compliance audit system
Collections.warningDescription: Browser data can be cleared and is not synchronized across devices. Export JSON regularly.
Collections.empty: No members yet. Enter an exact uuid@version.
Collections.error: This local data cannot be used. Check its format and size.

Methodology.title: Public-data methodology
Methodology.description: Every Portal capability is determined by public state, license, numeric context, and publication evidence together.
Methodology.visibility: Visibility is not a login state
Methodology.visibilityBody: Allowed metadata for state 100/200 can be discovered anonymously. Exchanges and LCIA still require separate capability and publication contracts.
Methodology.comparabilityBody: When functional unit, reference flow, method, geographic precision, time, or boundary conflict, only metadata is compared.
Methodology.provenanceBody: The Portal does not fill missing facts, invent Process Groups, or present inference as upstream evidence.
Methodology.withdrawalBody: Capability restrictions stop display. Exact-version links, publications, and the sitemap update under their respective freshness contracts.
